tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// thugs rje chen po mun sel sgron me'i las byang skal bzang 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ bde ldan zhing mgon 'od snang mtha' yas nyid// ye shes sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas par// rnam rol thugs rje chen po lhag pa'i lha// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med der btud nas// gang gi go 'phang bla na med pa'i sa// sgrub byed myur lam o rgyan thugs kyi bcud// zab gter gdams pa'i dgongs don 'jug bde'i khrigs// skal bzang rnams kyi 'dod 'jo'i dpyid du spel// de yang rten gyi gang zag dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa bla na med pa'i dngos grub myur du thob par 'dod pa dag gis tshul 'di la 'jug par bya ba yin no// de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po la yo byad kyi bsham dang*/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis kyi dang po ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas khang mdzes par brgyan/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'du bya ba'am sku gzugs rten dgram/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs phyi yi mchod pa dang*/ sman gtor rak+ta sogs nang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad rol mo'i khyad par sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro la/ bgegs bskrad skyabs sems tshad med bzhi// tshogs gsag byin 'beb mchod byin rlabs// zhes pa ltar bdun las dang po bgegs bskrad pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mchog rol pa'i skur bsam nas sngon 'gro gtor ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ mgron rnams bkug / oṃ sarba bigh+nān i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes gsum gyis bsngos nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te// rta skad rngam sgrog bar chad sel// sku yi 'od zer mtshon cha'i gur// me ri 'bar bas phyogs mtshams gcod// ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams// rnam rtog ma rig bag chags kyis// lha dang 'dre bgegs gnyis snang yang*// rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin phyir// 'dre bgegs rang gi sems las byung*// sems nyid ye nas chos sku la// bgegs dang bar chad ga la yod// thams cad rang grol chos sku'i mtshams// 'di la su yang 'da' ma byed// hrīḥhūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod nas gcad bya gcod byed thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pa'i gnas lugs shes pas mtshams bcad do// gnyis pa skyabs 'gro ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par byas nas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes dang*/ bdag dang rigs drug pha ma rnams/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro /gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du thugs rje chen po'i cho ga la 'jug par bya'o snyam du/ bdag gis 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar// rigs drug pha ma'i sdug bsngal skyob pa'i phyir// smon 'jug gnyis kyi lag len gnad sbyangs nas// theg mchog 'dir zhugs thugs rje chen po bsgrub// sgra dbyangs ma ṇis sems can skyob byed cing*// 'gro kun thugs rje'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces sems bskyed nas don dam byang chub sems kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa mi 'bral zhing*/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / snyam pas/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog / ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ lnga pa tshogs gsag pa ni/ skyabs yul rnams tshogs zhing du byas te/ hoḥ

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'dir gshegs shig /nyi zla pad gdan mdzes pa'i dbus su bzhugs// dad cing gus pas lus ngag yid phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang mchod dngos 'byor yid sprul 'bul// sdom pa gsum gyi nyams chag 'gal 'khrul bshags// dge 'dun rnams kyi dge la rjes yi rang*// dus gsum 'gro la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor// mya ngan mi 'da' sems can bskyab tu gsol// tshogs gnyis las byung dge ba byang chub bsngo// bdag gzhan bla med 'bras bu thob par shog / ces rgyud dag par byas nas tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdu/ drug pa byin 'beb pa ni/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par byas te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po yab yum 'khor dang bcas// chos kyi sku la sgrib rkyen mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i tshogs gsag bsnyen sgrub bya slad du// chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig /dbang skur byin phob mthu rtsal nus pa skyed// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥ.ā be sha ya a ā: zhes spos dang rol mor bcas pas byin dbab/ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas mchod rdzas kyi dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan so so'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ= de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai bid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ nyer gcig brjod pas/ oṃ gyis bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu ba'i byang sems su dkar mer gyis gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta ma hā pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes brjod/ āḥyis rak+ta 'khor ba yongs grol byang sems dmar por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ hūm̐ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung po snod bcud dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ hrīḥyis dam rdzas thams cad mtshan bcas der 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥdharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥku lan+ta hūm̐ hrīḥsarba ga ṇa pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lha bskyed byin rlabs spyan 'dren phyag /mchod bstod 'dzab bzla rdzogs rim mo// zhes bdun las dang po lha bskyed ni/ chos thams cad mi dmigs shing spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang las de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu'i snying rje mkha' khyab tu bsgom zhing stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi rang bzhin hrīḥdakar po'i rnam par bsgom ste/ a/ ye nas ma skyes stong gsal ngang*// oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ/ kun snang byang chub sems sprin las/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra sa mā ti oṃ/ hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa hrīḥdakar gsal/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na tsit+ta hrīḥ hrīḥlas bh+rūm̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang*// dal dbus pad+ma'i snying po zlum// 'dab drug mu khyud pad sdong mdzes// gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs// mnyam yangs 'od kyi khang par gsal// de dbus rang rig hrīḥ'od 'bar// rnam smin lus bsregs hrīḥde nyid// nyi zla pad steng thugs rje che// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// phyag g.yas pad phreng thugs kar 'dzin// g.yon pa pad steng bdud rtsi'i bum// rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs/ rang 'dra'i yum chen gsang ye ma// lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khril// 'ja' ris 'od lnga'i rgyab yol mdzes// hrīḥ

spyi gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med// mtha' yas zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mnyam gzhag phyag rgya bum pa 'dzin// skyil krung nyi zla pad+mar bzhugs// mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos spras// hrīḥ thugs kar rta mgrin dmar po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu gtsug na// rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher// phyag g.yas dbang sdud phyag rgya gdengs// phyag g.yon zhags pas log 'dren 'ching*// dur khrod chas gsol zhabs gnyis ni// mi ro'i steng na brkyang bskum bzhugs// tsit+ta'i sgo srung bar chad sel// hrīḥ rigs 'dus rang las sprul pa'i 'khor// nor 'dzin sras mchog g.yas nas 'dud// gsang sngags 'dzin ma g.yon nas 'dud// kun gyi spyi gtsug rigs lngas brgyan// hrīḥ 'dab drug pad+ma'i gdan steng du// lha yi thub pa oṃ dkar gsal// lha min thub pa ma sngon po// mi yi thub pa ṇi ser po// byol song thub pa pad ser nag /yi dwags thub pa me ljang dmar// dmyal ba'i thub pa hūm̐ mthing nag /kun kyang 'gro 'dul 'od zer 'gyed// hūm̐/ phyi rol pad skor bzhi ldan la// dus gsum sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// 'gro 'dul 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar// thugs rje chen po'i rol par gsal// hrīḥ sgo bzhir bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i steng*// shar sgor badz+ra he ru ka /dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdengs// lho sgor rat+na he ru ka /ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdengs// nub sgor pad+ma he ru ka /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdengs// byang sgor karma he ru ka /ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdengs// kun kyang 'dor stabs bdud bzhi brdzis// bla ma rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i sprin// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'gro ba drang zhing bsgral slad du// dug lnga'i tshul gyis dug lnga 'joms// sarba dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/

lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi mgrin snying gar sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās mtshan par bsam la/ hrīḥ ye nas rang byung thugs rje che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ni// ye shes lnga bdag cod pan dbang*// 'bru brgyad gsal bsgom rang dbang thob// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab bo// gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam la/ hrīḥ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don dgongs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru// ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten nas// thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku'i rnam rol 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal// sgrub pa'i lha mchog thugs rje chen po dang*// gsang ba ye shes sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// nor 'dzin gsang sngags 'dzin ma sras dang bcas// rgyal ba rigs drug sprul sku thub pa drug /dus gsum sangs rgyas stong rtsa thugs rje'i bdag /sgo skyong bdud 'dul ye shes khro bo bzhi// bla ma lha mchog rig 'dzin chos skyong tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥs ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes/ spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam mo// gsum pa phyag ni/ lha dang bdag gnyis med du rtogs pa'i tshul gyis/ hrīḥ snang ba yab la stong pa yum// snang stong dbyer med thugs rje che// thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ

a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phyag bya/ bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ kun 'byung nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// bdug spos me tog mar me dri// bshos gtsang sil snyan rol mo dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi dang*// 'dzin chags bral ba'i gtor ma dang*// rigs drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang*// gnyis med sbyar ba'i byang chub sems// kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol// mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni// sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs gtibs// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// bdag nyid chen po'i lha tshogs mchod// gnyis med dgyes par tshim gyur cig /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// thugs rje chen po sku yi lha// mtha' yas gsung la rta mgrin thugs// gsang ba ye shes kun gyi yum// nor 'dzin gsang sngags 'dzin ma sras// rgyal ba rigs drug thub pa drug /sangs rgyas stong rtsa khro chen bzhi// mchod bzhes dam skong dngos grub zhu// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ru ṇi kā gu h+ya dz+nyā na sarba yo gi nī badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza hoḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta hoḥ dharma dhā tu hoḥ sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod par bya'o// lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// zhal gcig rang byung ye shes gsal// phyag gnyis thabs shes 'gro ba 'dul// sku dmar 'khor 'das ye shes dbang*// rat+na'i rgyan phreng chos nyid rol// phyag g.yas pad phreng 'khor ba 'dren// g.yon pas bdud rtsis dug lnga 'joms// zhabs gnyis skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsang ye yum 'khyud chos dbyings sbyor// nyi zla pad gdan dug gsum dag

/'od lnga'i rgyab yol sku lnga rdzogs// ye nas rang byung thugs rje'i sku /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gsung*// 'gro ba'i mgon po tshe dpag med// mtha' bral thig le nyag gcig zhal// 'khor 'das mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can// spros bral ye shes bum pa 'dzin// bde gsal mi rtog mnyam pa'i dbyings// chos sku mi 'gyur skyil krung bzhugs// chos nyid rol pa'i mtshan dpe rdzogs// 'dren pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i thugs// snang srid dbang sdud rta mchog dpal// zang thal zhal gcig kun tu bzang*// rta gdong sa lam dus gcig gcod// 'khor 'das zil gnon rta skad sgrog /phyag g.yas thabs kyis srid dbang bsgyur// phyag g.yon shes rab 'gro kun 'dren// dur khrod chas kyis log lta 'joms// brkyang bskum zhabs kyis bdud bzhi 'dul// ro gdan chos sku lhun gyis grub// thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// hrīḥ rigs 'dus rang las sprul 'khor yang*// 'gro 'dul cha lugs cir yang ston// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bdag /bdud bzhi 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod par bya'o/ drug pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ 1$0000250tha mal ngag zhen bzlog pa'i phyir// thugs rje chen po thams cad kyi// yang snying 'dus pa 'di lta ste// 1$0000300 zhes gsungs pa'i don phyi nang gsang ba'i bzlas pa dang sbyar ba las/ dang po phyi sku gsung thugs kyi spro bsdu gsag sbyong gi tshul dang sbyar ba las bzla bya'i gzhi ni/ hrīḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'phro 'du ste// lha gsum thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// hrīḥmathar yi ge drug pas bskor// phyi ni gsag sbyong dngos grub sdud// ces pas gtso bo dang rta mgrin 'od dpag med gsum ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig mar me ltar 'bar ba sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba gsal btab nas/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i thugs ka nas// sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po 'phros// bde gshegs kun gyi sku la phog /sku mchog mnyes nas dngos grub thob// bdag la 'dus shing 'od zer des/ khams gsum sems can lus sgrib sbyangs// sems can lus kun dbang du gyur// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes ci nus bzla/ spyi gtsug snang mtha'i thugs ka nas// sngags phreng 'od zer dmar po 'phros| /bde gshegs kun gyi gsung la phog /gsung mnyes gsung gi dngos grub bsdus/ khams gsum sems can ngag sgrib sbyangs// sems can ngag kun dbang du 'dus// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes bzla/ rta mgrin thugs ka'i sngags phreng las// 'od zer mthing kha rab 'phros pas// bde gshegs kun gyi thugs la phog /thugs mchog mnyes nas dngos grub thob// bdag la 'dus shing 'od zer des/ khams gsum sems can yid sgrib sbyangs// sems can kun yid dbang 'dus gyur// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes bzla ste/ zhi ba'i ngag 'jam pos yi ge drug pa nyid dal zhing khug pa rma bya'i skad ltar bzla'o// gnyis pa nang drag pos tshar gcod kyi bzlas pa ni/

bdag nyid lha gsum thugs ka nas// sngags phreng khro chung mtshon thogs shing*// zhal nas phaṭa sgrog tshwa tshwa 'phro// stong gsum bkang nas log lta'i tshogs// gang dag zhi bas mi thul ba'i// bdud dang dgra bgegs brdung tshar bcad// kun kyang bran khol byed par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bcu gcig pa nyid 'ur chom grags pa ser 'brug ldir ba ltar ci rigs su bzla'o// gsum pa gsang ba don gyi zlas pa ni/ de ltar sku gsum lha mchog kyang*// bdag nyid thugs rje chen po la// 'dus te rnam pa yongs kyis med// gnyis med don gyi lhar gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i dgongs pa bzung nas rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ dang ma/ gnas pa ṇi dang pad/ phyir 'byin me dang hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes pa'i sgra gdangs rlung sngags dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang sbyar nas ci nus su bzla zhing des sun na ngag bzlas kyang ci rigs pa bya'o// bzhi pa gnas lugs bogs 'don gyi bzlas pa ni/ hrīḥ snang ba thugs rje chen po'i sku /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos// snang ba thams cad rang snang yin// ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥ sgra grags thugs rje chen po'i gsung*// tshig dang bral ba'i don la ltos// grags pa thams cad rang sgra yin// ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥ rtog tshogs thugs rje chen po'i thugs// ye shes zang thal ngang la zhog /grol ba thams cad rang grol yin// ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥ rang rig lha dang gnyis su med// gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos// lta byed rtog pa rang sar grol// bltas pas thugs rje che mi mthong*// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥ ma bltas bzhag pas lha dang mjal// ma bsgrub bzhag pas sangs rgyas 'grub// grub pa med do cir mi dgongs// rang byung thugs rje chen po yin// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ

hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes brjod cing*/ rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol du bskyal lo// gnyis pa gtor ma gtang ba ni/ gter srung gi gtor ma sogs gtor gral nas blangs la rdo rje'i 'gros kyis phyir bsgyur du bzhag /sman raka bran/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ hrīḥ dpal gyi gtor len dam tshig can// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma mo'i tshogs// sngon gyi dam bcas ma g.yel bar// dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// mi mthun tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol// badz+ra pra mo ha zlog bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas phyir 'bul/ gsum pa brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ gtor gzhong bshal ba'i phud kyis gtor ma bran la 'bru gsum gyis byin gyi brlab ste/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dgung sngon steng dang gangs ri g.ya' rtse dang*// spang ljongs skyed mos tshal dang nags 'dabs dang*// phyogs mtshams steng 'og dag na gnas pa yi// bod khams sgo skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs// slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// rang rang gnas 'dir gshegs la mchod gtor bzhes// rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor srungs phrin las mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul lo// bzhi pa bro brdung ba ni/ gtor gzhong kha sbub pa ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam la rdo rje'i rgyas btab nas/ hrīḥ thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor 'dir// bar gcod dam sri 'dul ba'i lha/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// gtum chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing*// dpal gyi rta skad tse re re/ khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem// bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog /hrīḥpad+mān+ta krita ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ya ma dam sri s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes bro brdung ngo*// lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam la/
